```artifact
Feature: Alarms and Temperature Monitoring

  Scenario: Battery failure alarm has high priority
    Given the system is initialized
    When a battery failure is detected
    Then the "battery failure" alarm should be triggered with high priority

  Scenario: System senses temperature of heating elements
    Given the system is initialized
    When the system is in operation
    Then the temperature of the blower motor should be sensed
    And the temperature of the battery cell should be sensed

  Scenario: GUI reads temperature sensors
    Given the system is initialized
    When the system is in operation
    Then the GUI should display the temperature of the blower motor
    And the GUI should display the temperature of the blower power mgmt system
    And the GUI should display the temperature of the battery cell

  Scenario Outline: GUI triggers "blower motor temperature too high" alarm
    Given the system is initialized
    When the temperature of the blower motor is above <threshold>
    Then the "blower motor temperature too high" alarm should be triggered
    Examples:
      | threshold |
      | 100       |
      | 150       |
      | 200       |

  Scenario Outline: GUI triggers "blower power system temperature too high" alarm
    Given the system is initialized
    When the temperature of the blower power mgmt system is above <threshold>
    Then the "blower power system temperature too high" alarm should be triggered
    Examples:
      | threshold |
      | 100       |
      | 150       |
      | 200       |

  Scenario Outline: GUI triggers "battery temperature too high" alarm
    Given the system is initialized
    When the temperature of the battery cell is above <threshold>
    Then the "battery temperature too high" alarm should be triggered
    Examples:
      | threshold |
      | 100       |
      | 150       |
      | 200       |

  Scenario Outline: GUI invokes safety action when blower power system temperature is above threshold
    Given the system is initialized
    When the temperature of the blower power mgmt system is above <threshold>
    Then the safety action should be invoked
    Examples:
      | threshold |
      | 100       |
      | 150       |
      | 200       |

  Scenario Outline: GUI invokes safety action when battery temperature is above threshold
    Given the system is initialized
    When the temperature of the battery cell is above <threshold>
    Then the safety action should be invoked
    Examples:
      | threshold |
      | 100       |
      | 150       |
      | 200       |
```
